answer: Each identity’s standing is an atlas drawn only from reciprocal relationships — it must both give real help and receive real help, each exchange verified by both sides. An umber of trust grows only where help flows both ways, and a nebula of standing forms slowly, one mutual exchange at a time, so a farm of a thousand fakes stays dark: fakes can pretend to help each other, but no established identity will both accept their help and offer help in return, and a fake that only takes, or only gives, has no atlas at all.
